IToken._update is guarded by whenNotPaused, and BaseUpgradeable.pause() is EMERGENCY_ROLE-gated: this is a live global transfer-pause authority, not an active holder-targeted blacklist. The current IToken and inherited source have no address blacklist, transfer allowlist, seizure, privileged arbitrary-holder burn or forced transfer. hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE,0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02)=true; getMinDelay()=172800 seconds, and UUPS upgrades are DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated. Both pause and upgrade surfaces therefore establish direct Possible, not Yes. Materiality: the 2026-10-19 supply data have no distribution. Pinned Ethereum totalSupply=29932237545115 and balanceOf(OFT adapter 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a)=1645908638659 raw six-decimal units give unescrowed Ethereum supply 28,286,328.906456 thBILL (94.501218% of canonical totalSupply), decisively material. The same-day remote supply reads at Arbitrum 516204028 (2026-10-19T06:16:12+00:00), Base 52800558 (2026-10-19T06:14:23+00:00), HyperEVM 48936020 (2026-10-19T06:14:23+00:00) and Stable 43600771 (2026-10-19T06:16:12+00:00) are respectively 362562666588, 215960991, 1282881899150, and 31912225 raw units. They are all below 10%; their direct non-proxy ThBillOFT runtimes match Sourcify verified source (outside compiler-declared immutable slots where needed). The OFT source has ordinary local ERC20 transfers and no local blacklist, pause, upgrade or arbitrary-holder burn. Remote bridge owner/delegate configuration is not a local transfer freeze. Pins are not synchronized; remote sum differs from Ethereum escrow by 216.199705 thBILL, so these are approximate cross-chain shares, not a fully reconciled supply attestation; this does not threaten Ethereum's >94% materiality. There is no declared parent. Institutional fund/custodial reserves are secondary upstream exposure and cannot override the direct Possible tier.
